verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions MCP. The 'server' references are to the headless simulation server, and Gazebo Transport is socket-based pub/sub messaging; neither is an MCP endpoint, and probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
